answer: By anchoring each agent identity to a lattice-based keypair whose public commitment is seeded from a unique physical knoll coordinate, the economy forces sybils to duplicate scarce attested entropy rather than merely mint keys. A delay-tolerant bridge relays these commitments through LDPC-coded bundles, so any fork in the identity crystal becomes detectable as parity. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
